title: Checkpoint 4: clean-clone completion gate
description:
Run the repository completion gate from a clean clone and capture automated test and demo evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
The complete vertical slice runs from a clean clone with no manual database edits, all material failure paths pass, and the roadmap completion gate can be checked.
acceptance_criteria: The complete vertical slice runs from a clean clone with no manual database edits, all material failure paths pass, and the roadmap completion gate can be checked.

title: Build seed, reset, and end-to-end harness skeleton
description:
Create deterministic seed and reset commands, fixture loading, environment checks, test orchestration, and machine-readable result reporting around the existing ontology, events, and Salesforce metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean environment can validate prerequisites, seed and reset the synthetic case repeatedly, and report deterministic pass or failure before all feature lanes are connected.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment can validate prerequisites, seed and reset the synthetic case repeatedly, and report deterministic pass or failure before all feature lanes are connected.
close_reason: PR #19 merged; prerequisite checks, scoped reset, deterministic seed, fixture verification, governed Apex context verification, JSON reporting, and failure-path unit tests pass. Two consecutive dev-ed runs and standalone reset/restore passed.

title: Verify and document the clean-clone vertical slice
description:
Connect the complete end-to-end test, material failure paths, demo runbook, recovery steps, and evidence capture after all product lanes are integrated.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean clone reproduces ingestion through evaluated outcome with no manual database edits, and the runbook identifies every command, expected result, and recovery path.
acceptance_criteria: A clean clone reproduces ingestion through evaluated outcome with no manual database edits, and the runbook identifies every command, expected result, and recovery path.

title: Checkpoint 1: contracts frozen
description:
Review and freeze the Apex, MuleSoft, model gateway, and UI state contracts used by all four lanes. Contract changes after this gate require an explicit compatibility note and affected-lane review.

## Acceptance Criteria
All contract beads are closed, examples are versioned, cross-lane names and identifiers agree, and each lane records its compatibility command.
acceptance_criteria: All contract beads are closed, examples are versioned, cross-lane names and identifiers agree, and each lane records its compatibility command.
close_reason: All four version 1.0.0 contracts are merged, versioned examples agree on tenant/correlation/purpose semantics, compatibility commands are recorded, npm run check passes, and Salesforce contract tests pass.

title: Checkpoint 2: lanes independently verified
description:
Review each lane in isolation before connected integration: Apex services, MuleSoft mocks, model routing, mock-backed UI, and seed/reset harness.

## Acceptance Criteria
Every lane passes its local success and material failure tests, publishes evidence, and can be exercised without unfinished downstream lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Every lane passes its local success and material failure tests, publishes evidence, and can be exercised without unfinished downstream lanes.
close_reason: All four lanes independently verify: Apex services and failures, MuleSoft contracts/retries/callbacks, model routing/fallback/fail-closed behavior, Lightning mock/live states, and repeatable seed/reset harness.

title: Checkpoint 3: connected governed behavior
description:
Verify the connected Salesforce, MuleSoft, model gateway, Agentforce, and Lightning behavior with permissions and human approval enforced.

## Acceptance Criteria
The synthetic case reaches a correlated outcome through the connected interfaces; inaccessible evidence, unapproved action, and unqualified model paths fail closed.
acceptance_criteria: The synthetic case reaches a correlated outcome through the connected interfaces; inaccessible evidence, unapproved action, and unqualified model paths fail closed.
close_reason: Connected demo repeatedly reached a correlated Salesforce outcome through model gateway, Agentforce, human approval, MuleSoft write-back, evaluation, and Lightning refresh; inaccessible evidence, unqualified model, and unapproved action paths failed closed in PR #22.

title: Build mock-backed Lightning command center
description:
Define versioned UI state fixtures and build the command-center shell, relationship context, timeline, owner and blockers, evidence, SOP status, recommendation, approval controls, action history, outcome state, loading, empty, denied, and error views against mock data.

## Acceptance Criteria
The full synthetic case and material UI states render from stable fixtures with accessibility and Jest coverage, without waiting for live Apex services.
acceptance_criteria: The full synthetic case and material UI states render from stable fixtures with accessibility and Jest coverage, without waiting for live Apex services.
close_reason: Versioned full, restricted, loading, empty, denied, and error states render with 11 Jest tests; Salesforce check-only deployment passed; PR #16 merged.

title: Wire Lightning command center to governed services
description:
Replace mock transport with the frozen Apex service interface, enforce permission-appropriate controls, preserve the same UI state contract, and verify refresh after approval, action, and outcome changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
A permitted user completes the connected vertical slice from one UI while restricted roles see consistent facts and only authorized controls.
acceptance_criteria: A permitted user completes the connected vertical slice from one UI while restricted roles see consistent facts and only authorized controls.
close_reason: PR #18 merged; live Apex transport, server-derived controls, approval decision refresh, restricted-role behavior, and additive context mapping pass 15 LWC tests and deployed successfully to dev-ed with 13 Apex tests.

title: Freeze MuleSoft OpenAPI and callback contracts
description:
Define versioned OpenAPI contracts and examples for event ingestion, context retrieval, action execution, and outcome callbacks, including idempotency, correlation, retryability, and stable error envelopes.

## Acceptance Criteria
OpenAPI validation passes and every operation has request, success, denial, conflict, validation, retryable-failure, and callback examples.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI validation passes and every operation has request, success, denial, conflict, validation, retryable-failure, and callback examples.
close_reason: OpenAPI 3.1 validation passes; all four operations have schema-valid request, success, denial, conflict, validation, retryable-failure, and callback examples; PR #11 merged.

title: Implement MuleSoft mock source and write-back adapters
description:
Implement replaceable mocked source and write-back behavior behind the frozen APIs, including deterministic idempotency, correlation propagation, retries, and outcome callbacks.

## Acceptance Criteria
The synthetic event can be ingested and an approved mocked action produces a correlated outcome callback without changing the API contracts.
acceptance_criteria: The synthetic event can be ingested and an approved mocked action produces a correlated outcome callback without changing the API contracts.
close_reason: Synthetic event intake and approved mock write-back produce one correlated, idempotent outcome callback; retry and fail-closed tests pass; PR #12 merged.

title: Stress-test MuleSoft contracts and adapter failures
description:
Add contract and adapter tests for duplicates, malformed payloads, conflicts, timeout and retry, callback replay, non-retryable failure, and correlation.

## Acceptance Criteria
Contract tests deterministically prove idempotency, errors, correlation, retries, callback replay, and failure classification.
acceptance_criteria: Contract tests deterministically prove idempotency, errors, correlation, retries, callback replay, and failure classification.
close_reason: Twelve contract and adapter tests prove idempotency, malformed-input errors, conflicts, correlation, dependency and callback retries, callback replay, and failure classification; PR #13 merged.

title: Freeze provider-neutral model gateway contracts
description:
Define logical model profiles, deployment descriptors, routing inputs and outputs, prompt and response envelopes, policy constraints, invocation audit fields, and qualified fallback semantics without binding business workflows to a provider.

## Acceptance Criteria
Two mock provider deployments satisfy one versioned gateway contract, and routing and audit fixtures are consumable without provider-specific workflow logic.
acceptance_criteria: Two mock provider deployments satisfy one versioned gateway contract, and routing and audit fixtures are consumable without provider-specific workflow logic.
close_reason: Provider-neutral schemas and 16 typed fixtures validate two interchangeable deployments, qualified fallback, failed-closed routing, normalized output, hashes, and invocation audit; PR #14 merged.

title: Implement and verify model routing, adapters, and audit
description:
Implement deterministic profile selection, two mock provider adapters, policy-qualified fallback, invocation audit, and tests for sensitivity, residency, capability, availability, and invalid output.

## Acceptance Criteria
The same recommendation request switches between two qualified mock deployments, records policy and deployment versions, and fails closed when no deployment qualifies.
acceptance_criteria: The same recommendation request switches between two qualified mock deployments, records policy and deployment versions, and fails closed when no deployment qualifies.
close_reason: Deterministic routing, two mock adapters, qualified fallback, invalid-output handling, failed-closed policy, and versioned invocation audits pass nine runtime tests; PR #15 merged.

title: Freeze Apex service contracts and authorization matrix
description:
Define versioned request and response DTOs, service method boundaries, sharing behavior, CRUD and FLS enforcement, custom-permission checks, transaction boundaries, and named error results for context, recommendation, approval, action, outcome, and provenance operations.

## Acceptance Criteria
Contract fixtures compile, the authorization matrix covers every operation and role, and downstream lanes can build against stable DTO examples without an Apex implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Contract fixtures compile, the authorization matrix covers every operation and role, and downstream lanes can build against stable DTO examples without an Apex implementation.
close_reason: Apex service contract v1.0.0 implemented with top-level Lightning-compatible DTOs, seven-operation service interface, named errors, executable CRUD/FLS/custom-permission authorization matrix, transaction boundaries, serialized fixtures, and four passing org tests. Deployed 18 API 66.0 Apex components to dev-ed as 0AfdL00000bYKWrSAO with 98% org-wide coverage.

title: Implement Apex context and action service behavior
description:
Implement bulk-safe context and provenance reads plus recommendation, approval, action, and outcome commands against the frozen service contracts. Preserve tenant keys, correlation, source evidence, state transitions, and transaction integrity.

## Acceptance Criteria
All frozen service operations work for the synthetic vertical-slice case and enforce sharing, CRUD, FLS, custom permissions, valid state transitions, and correlation.
acceptance_criteria: All frozen service operations work for the synthetic vertical-slice case and enforce sharing, CRUD, FLS, custom permissions, valid state transitions, and correlation.
close_reason: Implemented user-mode with-sharing Apex context and provenance graph reads plus recommendation, approval, action, and outcome commands with tenant enforcement, custom permissions, state validation, deterministic replay, server-owned decision metadata, and rollback-protected terminal outcome updates. Deployed 23 Apex components to dev-ed as 0AfdL00000baqVpSAI; independent run 707dL00001Adg26 passed 9/9 with 86% coverage.

title: Stress-test Apex services and failure paths
description:
Add focused Apex tests for success, denial, inaccessible evidence, invalid state, duplicate command, rollback, and partial failure, including realistic role execution.

## Acceptance Criteria
Apex tests pass in the connected org and prove success, denial, invalid-state, duplicate, rollback, and partial-failure behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Apex tests pass in the connected org and prove success, denial, invalid-state, duplicate, rollback, and partial-failure behavior.
close_reason: Added org-backed stress coverage for deployed relationship, approver, and integration permission sets; cross-role denial; inaccessible evidence; invalid state; conflicting duplicate commands; and rollback after a post-insert action validation failure. Deployed as 0AfdL00000bas2zSAA and independently passed 12/12 tests in run 707dL00001AeQ8p with 87% coverage.

title: Partition vertical slice into four developer lanes
description:
Split the remaining vertical-slice work into four stable ownership lanes with claimable leaf beads, explicit contract and integration checkpoints, file ownership guidance, and a repeatable status view.

## Acceptance Criteria
Four developers can immediately claim one ready leaf each, understand their interfaces and file boundaries, and see objective checkpoint status without relying on chat history.
acceptance_criteria: Four developers can immediately claim one ready leaf each, understand their interfaces and file boundaries, and see objective checkpoint status without relying on chat history.
close_reason: Four ownership lanes, eighteen claimable or gated leaf/checkpoint beads, precise dependencies, collision rules, and a team status command are implemented; one ready starting bead is visible for each developer.

title: Implement provider-neutral model gateway contract
description:
Define logical model profiles, deployment records, routing policies, invocation audit, Salesforce AI Models integration, LLM Open Connector adapter contract, and qualified fallback behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
The vertical slice can switch between two qualified mock model deployments without changing its business workflow, prompt contract, or action logic, and every invocation records the selected deployment and policy version.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.
close_reason: Provider-neutral model gateway contracts, routing, adapters, fallback, and audit are implemented, verified, and merged.

title: Define model portability and governed experimentation architecture
description:
Define how Agentforce, Salesforce AI Models, BYOLLM, custom providers, and on-prem models connect without leaking provider assumptions into business workflows. Define a governed AutoResearch-style evaluation loop outside production.

## Acceptance Criteria
The repository contains an architecture diagram, model gateway contracts, on-prem constraints, experiment safety boundaries, and linked implementation work.
close_reason: Model portability, on-prem constraints, Salesforce connection surfaces, and governed AutoResearch-style experimentation are documented with implementation beads.

title: Persist roadmap research and recovery protocol
description:
Commit the roadmap, research archive, architecture decisions, development boundaries, source-fetching utility, and agent recovery instructions.

## Acceptance Criteria
Repository documents pass validation and a fresh agent can identify product direction and ready work.
acceptance_criteria: Repository documents pass validation and a fresh agent can identify product direction and ready work.
close_reason: Roadmap, research archive, recovery protocol, decisions, tool boundary, and portable Beads graph validated.

title: Build Lightning command center
description:
Show relationship context, timeline, owner, blockers, evidence, SOP status, recommendation, approval controls, action history, and outcome.

## Acceptance Criteria
A user can complete the vertical slice from one coherent UI with permission-appropriate data.
acceptance_criteria: A user can complete the vertical slice from one coherent UI with permission-appropriate data.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.
close_reason: Both mock-backed and governed live Lightning command-center leaves pass acceptance and are merged; live metadata is deployed to dev-ed.

title: Automate vertical-slice verification and demo
description:
Create automated validation, seed and reset flow, end-to-end tests, and a concise demo runbook.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean environment reproduces the full vertical slice and all material failure-path tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment reproduces the full vertical slice and all material failure-path tests pass.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.

title: Scaffold Salesforce DX project
description:
Create the Salesforce DX structure, scratch or development environment documentation, manifests, and baseline test commands.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean clone can validate the Salesforce project structure and run its baseline checks.
acceptance_criteria: A clean clone can validate the Salesforce project structure and run its baseline checks.
close_reason: Salesforce DX scaffold, clean-clone checks, CI, and development documentation implemented.

title: Seed ontology and SHACL validation
description:
Create initial OWL classes, properties, JSON-LD context, SHACL shapes, and valid and invalid examples for the vertical slice.

## Acceptance Criteria
Valid examples pass and invalid examples fail with useful shape violations.
acceptance_criteria: Valid examples pass and invalid examples fail with useful shape violations.
close_reason: Seed OWL/SKOS vocabulary, JSON-LD context, SHACL shapes, named valid and invalid fixtures, and automated validation implemented.

title: Define event contract and synthetic case fixtures
description:
Define the versioned event envelope and a domain-neutral case spanning person, organization, employee, supplier, agreement, SOP, and issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
Fixtures cover normal, duplicate, malformed, late, and conflicting inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover normal, duplicate, malformed, late, and conflicting inputs.
close_reason: Versioned CloudEvents-compatible envelope, domain-neutral synthetic case, and deterministic normal, duplicate, malformed, late, conflicting, out-of-order, hash, and idempotency fixtures implemented.

title: Create core Salesforce metadata
description:
Create initial objects and fields for entities, relationships, events, participants, agreements, work, SOP execution, evidence, recommendations, approvals, actions, outcomes, and evaluations.

## Acceptance Criteria
Metadata deploys and enforces required relationships and access assumptions for the vertical slice.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata deploys and enforces required relationships and access assumptions for the vertical slice.
close_reason: Deployed 13 core Salesforce objects with required relationship chains, validation rules, three role permission sets, custom approval/action permissions, deterministic generation checks, and a rollback smoke test to API 66.0 dev-ed (deploy 0AfdL00000bYBwbSAG).

title: Implement Apex context and action services
description:
Implement context retrieval, recommendation storage, approval, action logging, outcome capture, provenance lookup, and tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
Services pass success, denial, invalid-state, and partial-failure tests.
acceptance_criteria: Services pass success, denial, invalid-state, and partial-failure tests.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.
close_reason: All Core Apex leaves are complete: versioned contracts and authorization matrix, governed relationship service behavior, and realistic role/failure-path verification are deployed and passing in the connected Salesforce org.

title: Define MuleSoft APIs and mock adapters
description:
Create OpenAPI contracts for ingestion, context, action execution, and outcome callbacks plus mocked source and write-back behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
Contract tests prove idempotency, error responses, correlation, retries, and outcome callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Contract tests prove idempotency, error responses, correlation, retries, and outcome callbacks.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.
close_reason: All Integration lane contract, mock adapter, callback, idempotency, retry, and failure-verification leaves passed and merged.

title: First complete vertical slice
description:
Deliver source event through mapping, work, recommendation, approval, mocked action, outcome, and updated user view.

## Success Criteria
The entire path runs from a clean clone with automated tests and no manual database edits.
acceptance_criteria: The entire path runs from a clean clone with automated tests and no manual database edits.

title: C12 Security governance and enterprise readiness
description:
Implement isolation, authorization, purpose, consent, retention, segregation of duties, agent audit, recovery, and connector replacement tests.

## Success Criteria
Security, privacy, failure recovery, and real-source replacement tests pass without weakening audit history.
acceptance_criteria: Security, privacy, failure recovery, and real-source replacement tests pass without weakening audit history.

title: C01 Source intake and event contracts
description:
Implement MuleSoft source boundaries, versioned event contracts, source preservation, retries, replay, deduplication, and synthetic feeds.

## Success Criteria
Valid, duplicate, malformed, late, missing, and out-of-order events produce deterministic observable results.
acceptance_criteria: Valid, duplicate, malformed, late, missing, and out-of-order events produce deterministic observable results.

title: C02 Shared semantics and provenance
description:
Define OWL and SKOS vocabulary, SHACL validation, PROV-compatible provenance, mappings, and bitemporal assertions.

## Success Criteria
Examples validate, preserve source terminology, and answer current-state and historical-belief questions.
acceptance_criteria: Examples validate, preserve source terminology, and answer current-state and historical-belief questions.

title: C03 Identity relationships and history
description:
Resolve source identities with visible confidence, corrections, typed relationships, participants, and evidence-bearing history.

## Success Criteria
Users can inspect, explain, correct, and traverse identities and relationship history.
acceptance_criteria: Users can inspect, explain, correct, and traverse identities and relationship history.

title: C04 Cross-functional work and SOP execution
description:
Implement work items, ownership, dependencies, executable SOPs, evidence requirements, escalation, handoffs, and verified closure.

## Success Criteria
One domain-neutral case crosses teams, supplier, agreement, SOP, and approval without losing context.
acceptance_criteria: One domain-neutral case crosses teams, supplier, agreement, SOP, and approval without losing context.

title: C00 Project control and recovery
description:
Make product direction, evidence, decisions, work dependencies, and clean-session recovery durable in the repository.

## Success Criteria
A new collaborator can clone the repo, understand the product, inspect research, run bd prime, and identify unblocked work without prior chat.
acceptance_criteria: A new collaborator can clone the repo, understand the product, inspect research, run bd prime, and identify unblocked work without prior chat.
close_reason: Clean-clone recovery test passed and foundation checkpoint is committed in repository artifacts.

title: Freeze Agentforce explanation and action contracts
description:
Define grounded explanation, evidence citation, recommendation request, approval request, refusal, and error contracts using the frozen Apex, MuleSoft, and model gateway interfaces.

## Acceptance Criteria
Agent action schemas and fixtures distinguish facts from inference, cite evidence identifiers, and define inaccessible-data and unauthorized-action refusals.
acceptance_criteria: Agent action schemas and fixtures distinguish facts from inference, cite evidence identifiers, and define inaccessible-data and unauthorized-action refusals.
close_reason: Agentforce schemas, grounded fixtures, refusal contracts, documentation, and full repository checks passed in PR #20.

title: Implement and stress-test Agentforce actions
description:
Implement Agentforce-accessible explanation, recommendation, and approval-request actions without autonomous external execution, then test permissions, grounding, refusal, and audit behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
Agentforce cites accessible evidence, refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions, records model invocation provenance, and cannot bypass human approval.
acceptance_criteria: Agentforce cites accessible evidence, refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions, records model invocation provenance, and cannot bypass human approval.
close_reason: Agentforce explanation, qualified recommendation, and pending approval actions passed 19 Apex tests, repository checks, deployment, and PR #21.

title: Build governed evaluation and experiment registry
description:
Implement versioned evaluation suites, authorized dataset snapshots, experiment runs, candidate lineage, multi-metric scoring, and human promotion records for bounded AutoResearch-style loops.

## Acceptance Criteria
An isolated experiment can compare a baseline and candidate, retain all results, reject regressions, and require human promotion before changing production configuration.

title: Expose Agentforce explanation and approval actions
description:
Expose grounded case explanation, evidence citations, recommendation generation, and approval request actions without autonomous execution.

## Acceptance Criteria
Agentforce refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions and cites evidence for supported answers.
acceptance_criteria: Agentforce refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions and cites evidence for supported answers.
notes: Coordination parent. Claim its leaf beads, not this parent.
close_reason: Agentforce contracts and governed action implementation are complete; no external-execution action is exposed.

title: C11 Product memory and outcome learning
description:
Implement permission-aware episodic, semantic, procedural, and outcome memory with reviewed promotion and evaluation.

## Success Criteria
A later recommendation can cite a relevant prior outcome, explain applicability, and respect current permissions.
acceptance_criteria: A later recommendation can cite a relevant prior outcome, explain applicability, and respect current permissions.

title: C05 Metrics and attribution
description:
Implement versioned metric definitions and reproducible attribution for any defined business outcome.

## Success Criteria
Independent recalculation from source events reproduces displayed metrics and attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Independent recalculation from source events reproduces displayed metrics and attribution.

title: C06 Recommendations and predictive signals
description:
Build transparent baseline rules, predictive signals, evidence-backed recommendations, hypotheses, and explainable Agentforce responses.

## Success Criteria
Every recommendation is explainable from accessible evidence and can be rejected without changing source facts.
acceptance_criteria: Every recommendation is explainable from accessible evidence and can be rejected without changing source facts.

title: C07 Human approval actions and outreach
description:
Implement policy checks, approvals, controlled actions, consent and channel enforcement, grounded messages, and write-back audit.

## Success Criteria
No protected external action occurs without required identity, permission, policy, and approval checks.
acceptance_criteria: No protected external action occurs without required identity, permission, policy, and approval checks.

title: C08 User surfaces
description:
Build command center, queues, relationship explorer, evidence timeline, approvals, role views, Slack access, and Tableau views.

## Success Criteria
Roles see consistent facts with permission-appropriate access and actions.
acceptance_criteria: Roles see consistent facts with permission-appropriate access and actions.

title: C09 Workforce relationships
description:
Map skills, role requirements, feedback, development, workload, opportunities, and restricted employee cases.

## Success Criteria
The system proposes evidence-backed staffing or development actions without exposing protected employee data.
acceptance_criteria: The system proposes evidence-backed staffing or development actions without exposing protected employee data.

title: C10 Dependency and operational impact
description:
Map supplier, system, service, asset, contract, and organizational dependencies and coordinate remediation.

## Success Criteria
A failed dependency identifies affected relationships and commitments and tracks remediation to closure.
acceptance_criteria: A failed dependency identifies affected relationships and commitments and tracks remediation to closure.
